summary_en: Annual dividend forecast raised to 44 yen per share from 42 yen, with interim dividend of 21 yen and year-end dividend increased by 2 yen to 23 yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected mid-term results and improved profitability in core plant businesses.
title_en: Notice Regarding Difference Between FY2027 March Second Quarter (Interim Period) Consolidated Business Forecast and Actual Results and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Nikko Co., Ltd. revised upward its annual dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 to 44 yen per share from the previously announced 42 yen per share. The interim dividend remains at 21 yen, while the year-end dividend increased by 2 yen from 21 yen to 23 yen per share.

The increase reflects stronger-than-expected results in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating results surpassed prior forecasts due to progress in asphalt plant-related equipment replacement projects, steady demand for concrete plant-related equipment updates and maintenance services, benefits from price revisions, and improved project profitability. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders reached 26.30 yen per share versus the forecast of 20.77 yen.

The company positions stable and continuous dividend payments as an important management priority and took into account the improved profitability trajectory in its core plant businesses, solid order environment, better project margins, and overall financial condition in determining the higher year-end distribution.
